snippet.title: Draw With Me! (speed art + qna ft. WakeMeUpVN Reed's VA)
snippet.description:
It's so fun to draw Reed and make little sketches and doodles of him ngl 

Wake Me Up If You Need Me is a visual novel that will soon be released on itchio on March 31st (April 1st for those in Asia) right here: https://rice373.itch.io/wake-me-up-if-you-need-me

Thank you to Reed's VA (nahazuno) for making time to record this little qna with me!!! All the music in this video is from the game itself, and the art is by me :D

More about NaNoReNo:
https://itch.io/jam/nanoreno-2024

Follow my friend (Reed's voice actor) here:
https://www.instagram.com/nahazuno/

My socials:
Twitter: rice_373
